description: Connects a domain the merchant already owns to their RaxCube online store. Apply the groups separately: verify proves the domain is theirs, www points www at the store.
variableDescription: %token%: the one-time ownership code RaxCube issued for this domain (32 hex characters); %target%: the RaxCube edge host the store answers behind, as a label under raxcube.shop (for example customers)
